nifti_write — FILEIO nifti op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.nifti_write(volume, *, meta, compressed) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.nifti_write(volume, *, meta, compressed); from the registry, opsfileio.get("nifti_write"))

Usage

Write a 3-D/4-D array with affine/pixdim as single-file NIfTI-1 bytes.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

meta は affine と spatial_unit(m/mm/um)を必須とし、4-D では time_step と time_unit も必須。qform と sform の両方へ同じ affine を書く。compressed で .nii / .nii.gz 相当を選ぶ。呼び出し例:

nifti_write(vol, meta={"affine": affine, "spatial_unit": "mm"}, compressed=True)。
